about_the_game:
🎵 Idle Tycoon Manufacturing - Original Soundtrack 🎵

Immerse yourself in the soundscape of Idle Tycoon Manufacturing with the official soundtrack, gathering all the music from the game ! Catchy and atmospheric tracks that guide your industrial journey, blending management, strategy, and relaxation.

By purchasing this OST, you’ll not only enjoy the music outside the game, but also directly support the development of Idle Tycoon Manufacturing. A huge thank you for your support ! 💜

📀 Includes :
✔️ All in-game tracks in high quality
✔️ Free listening even outside the game
✔️ A concrete way to contribute to the project’s growth

Your support keeps the machines running ! Enjoy the music 🎶
